paragraphs.source_en:
S. reported to Claire in the letter cited that he had ‘not seen Mr. W.’ (L ii 257). However, the first meet-
ing with Edward Williams must have taken place on or by 19 January 1821 when Mary recorded in
her jnl ‘The Williams’s arrive — call on them & they come here’ (Mary Jnl i 349). She described him to
Claire in a letter of 21–24 January 1821 as
the picture of good humour and obligingness, he is lively and possesses great talent in
drawing so that with him one is never at a loss for subjects of conversation — He seems
to make all he sees subjects of surprize & pleasure.
 (Mary L i 180)
